name: Term life with living benefits
carrier: Mutual of Omaha (United of Omaha) / Americo

values.moo: Level death benefit for 10, 15, 20 or 30 years
values.americo: Level death benefit for 15, 20, 25 or 30 years

values.moo: Simplified underwriting that doesn't require a lengthy health inquiry
values.americo: No medical exam — a few medical questions on an instant-decision eApplication

values.moo: Requested benefit amount may not exceed 80 percent of the policy's face amount as of the policy issue date (each rider)
values.americo: Up to the full face, paid at a discount: about 79% of face when life expectancy is around 3 years, less the longer the life expectancy (Americo example: $100,000 → $79,206 at 3 years, $31,754 at 15, $5,762 at 25), after a $250 administrative charge

values.moo: Included at no additional cost — life expectancy of 12 months or less
values.americo: Included at no additional cost — a terminal illness expected to result in death within 12 months

values.moo: Included at no additional cost — certified by a physician within the last 12 months as unable to perform two of six Activities of Daily Living for 90 consecutive days, or requiring substantial supervision due to severe cognitive impairment
values.americo: Included at no additional cost — unable to perform two activities of daily living for a 90-day period, or needing substantial supervision due to severe cognitive impairment

rows.label: Critical illness

values.moo: Included at no additional cost — certified by a physician within the last 12 months with: ALS, kidney failure, life-threatening cancer, major organ failure, heart attack, stroke, dementia (including Alzheimer's), major burns, AIDS or aortic aneurysm surgery
values.americo: Included at no additional cost — diagnosed in the last 12 months with: ALS, end-stage renal (kidney) failure, invasive cancer, major organ failure, heart attack or stroke

rows.note: Definitions of chronic or critical illness may vary by state.

values.americo: Included on Term 125 — an extra 25% of the base death benefit for accidental death, plus another 25% if the accident happens as a fare-paying passenger on a common carrier

values.moo: If the primary residence sustains $25,000 or more of damage, premiums are waived for one six-month period
Premiums waived for one six-month period on qualifying unemployment
Additional death benefit equal to 100 percent of the original face amount or $250,000, whichever is less
Disability Income, Disability Waiver of Premium, Accidental Death Benefit, Dependent Children's Coverage
values.americo: Disability Income (up to $2,000/month for up to 2 years), Additional Insured (spouse, up to the base face), Children's Term (up to $15,000 per child, to age 25), Waiver of Premium for Disability (adds Involuntary Unemployment Waiver, up to 6 months), Income Term Rider

notes: Accelerated death benefits are not expected to receive the same favorable tax treatment as other types of accelerated death benefits; see a tax advisor.
Suicide exclusion: two years from issue (one year in CO, MO and ND); premiums paid are returned instead.
Accelerated death benefits are not expected to receive the same favorable tax treatment as other types of accelerated death benefits; see a tax advisor.
Suicide exclusion: two years from issue (one year in CO, MO and ND); premiums paid are returned instead.
